question: Does a stock-specific T+1 entry gap relative to 399102 contribute to the supported false-breakout topology?
mechanism: Gap-up execution may raise the entry basis after the signal, leaving limited favorable excursion before an internal opportunity-then-adversity reversal.
prediction: Action-safe stock-minus-market signal-close-to-T+1-open gap is positively and stably associated with false breakouts and with the H-016 MFE-before-MAE topology after pre-entry and market controls.
interpretation_boundary: Every accepted fill is exactly the T+1 open. The experiment tests overnight entry timing, not intraday slippage, and does not test avoiding or resizing a fill.

sample.execution: all 399 completed entries fill exactly at the next trading-session open
sample.eligibility: exact accepted fill plus hard-valid signal and execution bars plus valid corporate-action coordinate and 399102 close/open
sample.missingness: fail closed; no fill substitution, price imputation, post-entry extension, or replay

primary_feature: log(action-safe stock T+1 execution-open / signal close) minus log(399102 T+1 open / signal close)
topology_companion: positive association with H-016 oriented order, where positive means MFE occurs before MAE
fixed_neighbor: raw action-safe stock signal-close-to-T+1-open log gap without market subtraction

gates.raw: primary rho >= 0.10, positive within-year rank rho, and >=7/8 positive LOYO
gates.controlled: pre-entry/market partial-rank rho >= 0.10 and >=7/8 positive controlled LOYO
gates.topology: primary versus H-016 oriented-order rho >= 0.10, positive within-year rho, and >=7/8 positive LOYO
gates.neighbor: raw stock-gap rho positive with >=6/8 positive LOYO
gates.falsification: ex-Top-4 absolute gaps, ex-global-Bottom-4 P&L, no-action, and duration/exit estimates each >=0.05; >=80% positive leave-one-security and leave-one-industry omissions; >=2/3 positive baseline blocks

decision.REFINE: raw and controlled pass but at least one topology/neighbor/falsification gate fails

falsification: exact three-ledger hashes and one-to-one completed-cycle fill joins
execution price equals execution open exactly for all 399 cycles
one valid action-safe coordinate step for all 399 entries
fixed pre-entry market, breadth, beta, volatility, and liquidity controls
within-year ranks, per-year estimates, and eight LOYO omissions
global Bottom-4 P&L and Top-4 absolute-gap removal
zero post-entry rows, replays, counterfactual fills, or strategy rules
forbidden: calling the entry gap execution slippage or a deployable gap filter
testing an alternate fill, entry cancellation, sizing, ranking, exit, or production change
changing index subtraction, feature, endpoint, controls, neighbors, or gates after results
breadth historical redesign or invalid Phase 7/8/9 use
